what.text: This page follows refugees from China in Hong Kong, as UNHCR recorded them from 1964 to 1966.
UNHCR counted 1250040 at the end of 1966, 94.2% of all refugees from China that year.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left.
UCDP records no armed conflict involving China that was active from 1964 to 1966; the nearest are a conflict over Tibet territory in 1959 and an interstate conflict between China and India in 1962.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group cover only 1964 to 1966, rising from 1120000 to 1250040.
Today refugees from China live mainly in India and the United States.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees, with no breakdown by gender or age.
The sources don't say how people travelled, where in Hong Kong they lived or why the series stops after 1966.
